title: The Perfect Outfit
content:
Lily loves fashion and social media.

Every morning, she posts photos and videos of her outfits online. One day, she receives an invitation to a special event.

“I need the perfect outfit!” she says.

Lily opens her favorite shopping app and starts looking for clothes.

First, she finds a blue dress, but she is not sure about the size.

“Is this a small, medium, or large?” she wonders.

She checks the size guide and chooses a medium dress.

Then, she adds a white jacket, black shoes, and a pink handbag to her cart.

A few days later, her package arrives.

Lily tries on the dress.

“Oh no! It’s too big!”

She tries on the jacket.

“Perfect!”

Finally, she puts on her shoes and looks in the mirror.

She takes a photo and posts it on social media.

“New outfit for tonight! What do you think?”

A few minutes later, the likes and comments start appearing.

“I love your dress!”

“Your jacket looks amazing!”

“Where did you buy those shoes?”

Lily smiles and replies to her followers.

Her outfit was ready, her phone was full of notifications, and she was ready for a great night.
